description: Screenshot API for AI agents: send {url}, get JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF as base64 JSON. Options: viewport, full page, dark mode, selector. It does not get past bot protection (use unblock for those pages' text). Failed or blank captures aren't charged.

delayMs.description: extra wait after the page loaded, in milliseconds

format.description: image or document format of the capture; pdf is always the full page

fullPage.description: capture the whole scrollable page (height is capped at 16,384 px), not just the viewport

height.description: custom viewport height in pixels (ignored with fullPage)

selector.description: CSS selector: capture only the first matching element

url.description: absolute http or https URL of a public page, e.g. "https://example.com/"

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector to wait for before capturing

width.description: custom viewport width in pixels (overrides the device)

name: screenshot
title: Website screenshot or PDF of any URL
